**What does this PR change?**

- [ ] Adds new metric(s), protocol(s) or studies
- [ ] Adds or updates code / implementation links
- [ ] Fixes an alignment or color label
- [ ] Fixes a broken link or wrong metadata
- [ ] Other:

**Checklist**

- [ ] I edited the YAML under `data/`, not the generated files.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/build.py` and committed the regenerated `README.md`, `CODE.md` and `docs/index.html`.
- [ ] `align` reflects what the method needs (not just what it was tested on), with a `note` if unclear.
- [ ] Code links are the official repository or a maintained toolbox.
